en.description:
Fight alongside legendary pirates in your search of lost treasure, laying waste to all who cross your path. Haypi Pirates is a multiplayer strategy game where only the bravest and most resourceful players survive. Defeat the Spanish Armada, seize riches, join forces with other players, and dominate the high seas!

What you can find in the game:
Turn the seas into your very own kingdom!
Five treacherous waters hold a PVP showdown!
Recruit over 10 pirate officers to fight for you!
Armor your officers with powerful equipment!
Vanquish over a hundred enemies!
Fight through hundreds of levels!

Features
...Free to download! No registration required.
...Irresistible rewards for attendance, the Pirate Tourney, and infamy!
...Recruit notorious officers, give them amazing specialties, and forge powerful weapons! The sea is yours to command!
...5 levels of treacherous PVP waters are waiting. Only the strongest players can master them and conquer the seas. The more dangerous the waters, the better rewards you can get!
...Surprises everywhere: rare sea monsters that pop out of nowhere, merchant ships loaded with cargo, and drifting islands full of hidden treasure.
...Multiplayer interaction! Enter the Pirate Tourney, pillage other players, plunder their cargo ships, or join a guild...There are plenty of ways to reach the top!

Build a home base and perform frequent trades to create your pirate kingdom!
Become infamous with notorious officers and powerful equipment at your side!
Make your pirate kingdom impenetrable with advanced technology and wall reinforcements!
Arrange your officers and join a pirate guild to conquer the seas!

The grand adventure awaits you. Download the game and create your very own kingdom of pirates!
en.releaseNotes:
This update from Apple will improve the functionality of this app. No new features are included.

minor bugs fixed

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
1. Increased the chance of recruiting officers. Break Mary Read’s curse within 5 gambles!
2. The requirement for doubling battle animation speed has been lowered from players level 10+ to players level 8+.
3. The requirement for upgrading Ship Expansion technology to level 2 has been lowered from players level 15+ to players level 14+.
4. Guildies are marked with a different color on Open Waters. You will no longer have a headache telling your friends from your foes.
5. Some players encountered a blacked out screen when accessing the game. The chance of this has been reduced. 
6. Reduced the latency some players have experienced on Open Waters. 
7. Minor bugs fixed.
8. Optimized and smoothed out gameplay.

1.	The new version unlocks a new "fishing" feature:
Apart from battling with other pirates, you can relax by fishing with hundreds of attempts to catch fish.
Dozens of fish are waiting for you in different waters.
The fish you catch can be exchanged for a variety of items.
The Sea God may bless you and increase the success rate of fishing.
You may catch a guild fragment while fishing. After collecting certain number of fragments, the guild mode will be unlocked. Gather your members together to defeat the enemy! After a guild has won a guild battle, all members will receive a chest via mail.
You may also catch a treasure chest whilst fishing. Open to get rich rewards!

2.	Guild letters have been added.
3.	Guild officers can kick members out of the guild.
4.	The guild diplomacy is unlocked. You can set an enemy guild. The players from enemy guild are showed in red in open waters. 
5.	The guild managers can check the latest login status of all members.
6.	Name can be changed by the Helping Parrot. 
7.	Some bugs have been fixed to optimize the gaming experience.

1.  Chat room is now accessible through Fishing interface.
2.  Relevant optimizations made on Fishing feature.
3.  The display of enemy guild on Open Waters has been improved. 
4.  Some minor bugs have been fixed, making your adventure smoother.

The adventure in Pirates’ World becomes even more exciting:
1.  New scenes have been unlocked. 
Can ye imagine what awaits on yer treasure-huntin’ journey?
2.  New officer- Relentless Captain Ingo has been introduced. 
Cap’ns! Ye gonna recruit ’tis tough guy to strengthen yer crew. 
3.  The Fishing Contest has been kicked off.  
All participants will get a prize. Contest-toppers will get better prizes! ’Tis show time! 
4.   Fishing feature has been adjusted and optimized.  
a) Daily fishing attempts have been reduced;
b) Success rate of fishing has been increased.
It be bringin’ in more fun ‘n’ leisure!
5.  Kraken now inadvertently appears when you are fishing.  
’Tis be a good challenge fer cap’ns! We be goin’ ‘n’ get em’ Kraken Fragment(s)! Yo-ho-ho!
6.  Interactions between players have been improved during fishing. 
Now cap’ns will randomly intrude each other’s fishin’ areas during the fishin’ thingy. Cap’n, it seems someone be intrudin’ me fishing area. Chase em’ away! 
7.  Guild stipend, Tourney Reward, Daily Reward are now connected with the correspondent Open Waters Sections. Higher section offers better stuff. 
8.  Gameplay fairness has been enhanced. 
To avoid possible Open Waters bullying, higher-leveled players who intentionally linger on lower-leveled Open Water sections will experience certain restrictions from now on. 
9.  More in-game items have been added to the Guild Donation List.  
Crop, gold, materials, ocean tears, and various fragments are now able to be donated to your Guild.
10.  The drop rate of level 4 materials has been raised. 
Cap’ns gonna become stronger ‘n’ get higher rank equipment easier from now on. 
11.  The player level cap has been raised to LV 65.
12.  General optimizations have been made, making gameplay experience smoother.

The Guild Tourney is coming. Go and fight, Captain!
1. New Magic Circle has been unlocked. Collect Magic Stones to strengthen yourself.
2. The Guild Tourney has kicked off. The guild market is now open and a variety of rare items can be exchanged in here.
3. The Flash Mode has been added. Do more challenges and win better rewards.
4. The drop rate of LV4, LV5 special materials has been raised. Forging equipment is much faster.
5. New officer-the Eccentric Captain Neo has been introduced. Another strong helper joins your invincible crew.
6. The rate of triggering the fishing "random incidents" has been increased. You have a bigger chance to get some fishing surprises.
7. Newbie guidance has been improved. General optimizations have been made, making the gameplay experience smoother.
8. Battle animation speed is faster. The default option is 1x (equivalent to the previous 2x). LV20 or vip3 can unlock 2x (equivalent to the previous 4x).

1.The story of life at sea carries on and the pirates’ adventure becomes increasingly exciting.
2.New officers Charles and Lina will be glad to join your crew some day.
3.Equipment rank has been raised. 
Captns’ can have their equipment forged to Rank 8 and Rank 9 now.  
4.The infamy level, player level and equipment level caps have been raised to level 70.
5.Insurance can be bought to protect you from losing all ocean tears when the specialty upgrade fails.
6.Hidden levels are more convenient to access. 
Captns’ are now allowed to skip the battle video and to attack consecutively. 
7.The application has been optimized, making the gameplay smoother.

We’ve been quietly cookin’ up a storm t’ make something nice fer all ya! Now, that it be done, ye can put em’ in th’ water!

1.Battleship system has been introduced: 
a)Three types of battleships with their respective style and functionality await you.
b)Lead your battleships to tons of battles and grow with them
c)Equip various ship parts to your battleships and boost their capability.
d)Upgrade and improve your ship parts to strengthen the team. 

2.Dungeon system has been introduced: 
a)Explore further down in the Dungeon, defeat dangerous enemies and get booties. 
b)Climb up Dungeon rankings for infamy and reward(s).

3.The level cap for officers, equipment and buildings in Home Base has been raised to LV 75.  
4.Two new scenes have been unlocked. The pirates’ adventure carries on and goes even farther.
5.Two new officers have been introduced. 
6.General optimizations have been made. 
7.Smoother gameplay.

1. The cash issue occuring while doing "Smart Activate" has been fixed.
2. Error notification has been corrected. Previously, when you opened the Magic Box with a full Bag, the notification that players received was wrong.
3. The sidebar Helping Parrot and Reward Center icons flicker again.
4. General optimizations have been made.

1. The new emoticon pack in iOS 8.3 update is now supported. 
2. The chat input issue occured under Russian language environment has been fixed.
3. Some display issues have been improved.

This update from Apple will improve the functionality of this app. No new features are included.

minor bugs fixed
